4.source_text: Now, let us look at the place to which the Latter-day Saints are gathering. We cast our eyes towards the map of America, and the first thing that strikes us is the peculiar outline of the continent. We glance over the terrestrial globe, and see no land like it. From Jerusalem it is heyond the rivers of Ethiopia, very far off, and stretches out between the two great oceans in the shape of wings —…
